ios.desc:
For the public:
-Past and future departure information for all airports
-Past and future arrival information for all airports
-Individual flight info lookup


For flight attendants:
-Reminders if you forgot to sign in-Flight info
-ETB alerts
-Open time alerts
-Flight alerts
-Open time display
-Sequence details
-Calendar
-Reserve call out list
-Standby list
-Crew chat
-Save notes about crew members
-Display prior sequences flown together with others
-Pilot sequence info
-Legality checker
-Hotel amenities and pickup locations
-Find layover overlaps with other base's sequences
-Tracks cosmic radiation exposure
-Sequence total pay
